query:
WITH open AS (SELECT 1 FROM edges WHERE id = $1 AND valid_to IS NULL),
                 upd AS (
                    UPDATE edges
                       SET valid_to = now()
                     WHERE id = $1
                       AND valid_to IS NULL
                    RETURNING 1)
            SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM open) AS "open!", (SELECT count(*) FROM upd) AS "closed!"
